About.descriptionIntro: After two weeks in its classic format, ExpoJuy reinvents itself:
About.descriptionOutro: of morning business rounds and afternoon exhibits, with lithium mining and international trade as the central themes.

mineria.title: Mining and lithium
mineria.description: The RIGI regime approved for Exar will double lithium production to 45,000 tons. ExpoJuy connects Jujuy suppliers with that growing demand.

comercio.title: Foreign trade
comercio.description: Business rounds organized by the Jujuy Foreign Trade Chamber, with delegations that have already shown interest from other provinces and countries.

corredor.title: Bioceanic Corridor
corredor.description: Chile and Paraguay as strategic partners of the Capricorn Corridor — the 4-day format makes travel and lodging easier for foreign delegations.

conocimiento.title: Knowledge economy
conocimiento.description: The very sector driving this Digital Challenge: software, agtech and knowledge-based services, part of the province's 2026-2030 Strategic Plan.

Contact.title: Need something specific?
Contact.description: Write to us through whichever channel you prefer — you'll hear back from the same team at the Jujuy Foreign Trade Chamber that organizes ExpoJuy.
Contact.socialDescription: Announcements, dates and progress on the 2026 edition, in real time.

dates.question: When and where is ExpoJuy 2026?
dates.answer: From October 9 to 12, at Ciudad Cultural, San Salvador de Jujuy.

tickets.question: Do I need a ticket to visit the expo?
tickets.answer: In the 2024 edition admission was paid (reference prices in the Access section). There's no public confirmation yet of the 2026 scheme.

exhibitors.question: How do I register my company as an exhibitor?
exhibitors.answer: Through the Jujuy Foreign Trade Chamber's official call — there's no exhibitor sign-up on this site. You'll find the form and WhatsApp number in the Access section.

businessRounds.question: What are the business rounds?
businessRounds.answer: Morning meetings between Jujuy companies and Bioceanic Corridor delegations, organized by industry and shared interest. Check the directory in the Exhibitors section.

accessibility.question: Is the venue accessible for people with reduced mobility?
accessibility.answer: Message us on WhatsApp or email telling us what you need and we'll confirm the details before your visit.

parking.question: Is there parking?
parking.answer: Availability is confirmed by the organization closer to the date — ask us through our contact channels.

languages.question: What languages is the site available in?
languages.answer: Spanish, English, Portuguese and Mandarin — switch languages from the selector at the top left.

updates.question: How do I hear about updates?
updates.answer: Follow us on Instagram (@expojuy) or check the News section on this site.

Program.title: Four days, one steady rhythm
Program.description: Business rounds in the morning, expo in the afternoon — that's the 2026 format the organization confirmed. The detailed schedule of talks, panels and evening shows will be published closer to the date, as in the previous edition.
Program.afternoonContent: Expo open at Ciudad Cultural — stands, mining, foreign trade and the knowledge economy

News.title: The latest from ExpoJuy 2026
News.description: Real press coverage of this edition's announcement, plus updates on this site's own development.

sede-confirmada.title: Ciudad Cultural confirmed as the 2026 edition's venue
sede-confirmada.excerpt: The 17th ExpoJuy edition will run from October 9 to 12, cementing the new four-day format with morning business rounds and afternoon exhibits.

lanzamiento-oficial.title: Official launch: the focus shifts to international trade
lanzamiento-oficial.excerpt: The organization presented the 2026 edition centered on the Capricorn Bioceanic Corridor, with delegations expected from Chile, Paraguay and Brazil.

sadir-convocatoria.title: The Governor called on Jujuy companies to join in
sadir-convocatoria.excerpt: Carlos Sadir highlighted this edition's commercial focus and called on companies from the province to take part in the international business rounds.

sitio-mapa.title: The site adds an interactive map of the entire venue
sitio-mapa.excerpt: You can now browse Ciudad Cultural stand by stand from the Map section, with more than 200 spaces located and filterable by industry.
